verdict.rationale: Apple's first-party docs show an ecosystem built around Apple silicon. Xcode is pitched for building and testing apps on M4 Pro, and Metal comes with a debugger for inspecting and optimizing the rendering pipeline. ML tooling includes MLX for Apple Silicon, PyTorch Metal backends and Core ML. That covers the tier-one OS/tooling and GPU-optimization parts of the story, but nothing in the pack addresses compiler maturity or CPU-architecture optimization guidance. Missing for 10: evidence of mature compilers/toolchains (e.g., Clang/LLVM, Swift, or third-party compiler support for arm64), official CPU/architecture optimization guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration that developers treat it as a tier-one target.
